fusions.name: Lowing Note
fusions.desc: Sends a low note that deals 5 damage to the first enemy it meets. Each hit has a 25% chance of [Damped] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Rallying Bellow
fusions.desc: Bellows to the pod, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles of you. When it hits, every ally strikes 20% harder for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Huddle Warmth
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Warm Flank
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 6% sooner. It also regenerates 0.5 health a second, permanently.
